_comment: Single source of truth for the mod's tunable layout/appearance values. Embedded into the DLL at build (compile-time authoritative, baked into release with no disk IO). With Config.LiveTuning ON (debug), the running game watches THIS file and hot-applies edits — no recompile, no relaunch.

gem.incomingTip:
Incoming damage
x / y  —  the HP you'll actually lose this turn if you end now (after block)
over the raw damage the enemies are outputting.
gem.offenseTip:
Your damage
x / y  —  the most HP you can deal this turn over that plus damage that lands before
your next play (poison, start-of-turn effects, …). Hover an enemy to scope both numbers to it.
